pages.text: Flavoring is split into two ingredients: $(thing)Aqua Vitae$(), the extraction spirit, and concentrated $(thing)Flavoring Essence$(). Molasses supplies the heavy sweetness and moisture used for shisha.

pages.title: Aqua Vitae
pages.text: First brew the vanilla $(item)Mundane Potion$() from a Water Bottle and Sugar. Brew that Mundane Potion with $(item)Wheat$() to make a Bottle of Aqua Vitae. Aqua Vitae is an extraction ingredient, not a drinking mechanic.

pages.title: Flavoring Essence
pages.text: Brew $(item)Aqua Vitae + a flavor ingredient$() to make that ingredient's Flavoring Essence. Each essence bottle is $(item)single-use$(). Apple makes Apple Essence, Cocoa Beans make Cocoa Essence, and so on.

pages.title: Plain Molasses
pages.text: Plain molasses keeps its simple Brewing Stand route: brew a vanilla $(item)Water Bottle$() with $(item)Sugar Cane$() to make one full Bottle of Molasses.

pages.title: Two Uses for Essence
pages.text: Use $(item)1 essence bottle + loose tobacco$() to lightly case it into aromatic tobacco. Or craft $(item)1 essence bottle + 1 plain Molasses bottle$() to make a full one-use bottle of flavored molasses for wet shisha.

pages.title: Create Automation
pages.text: With Create installed, a $(thing)heated Mechanical Mixer$() can make Aqua Vitae from Water + Sugar + Wheat, make Essence from Aqua Vitae + its flavor ingredient, and make plain molasses from Water + Sugar Cane. A Spout applies 1000 mB Essence to loose tobacco; a Mixer combines 1000 mB Essence with 1000 mB plain molasses.
